properties.name: Kiel Canal (Nord-Ostsee-Kanal)
properties.source: Geometry: centre line of OSM waterway=canal ways 1470915264, 1470915263, 144489148, 144489145, 1470915265, 144489147, 144489146, 60144851; OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), retrieved 2026-10-16 via the Overpass API and simplified to 3 m
properties.note: Brunsbüttel locks: both large chambers (usable 310 m x 42 m), from the Elbe outer harbour to the canal. The small 1895 chambers (125 m x 22 m) are left out. Width checked against the OSM lock and canal areas: the 40 m corridor stays inside water (42 m would touch the walls). It must be at least about 38 m so that harbour-level cells (~18 m) lying entirely inside it form an edge-connected chain on any heading.

properties.name: Kiel Canal (Nord-Ostsee-Kanal)
properties.limits_note: Ships of the maximum length and beam may draw 7.0 m; the 9.5 m draught applies to ships up to 160 m long. Fixed bridges have 42 m clearance, so the air draft limit is 40 m.
source: Geometry: centre line of OSM waterway=canal ways 30417811, 1490472671, 857248328, 50250427, 59908473; OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), retrieved 2026-10-16 via the Overpass API and simplified to 3 m

Limits: Seeschifffahrtsstraßen-Ordnung § 42 with the dimensions published under § 60 (https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/seeschstro_1971/__42.html), as summarised at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiel_Canal (retrieved 2026-10-16)
properties.note: The canal from the Brunsbüttel inner harbour to the Kiel-Holtenau inner harbour (about 95 km along this line). The 60 m corridor stays inside the OSM canal area along its whole length; a 70 m corridor would touch the banks in places.

properties.name: Kiel Canal (Nord-Ostsee-Kanal)
properties.source: Geometry: centre line of OSM waterway=canal ways 59908522, 131279453, 1460296571, 59908544, 131279454, 1460296572; OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), retrieved 2026-10-16 via the Overpass API and simplified to 3 m
properties.note: Kiel-Holtenau locks: both new chambers (310 m x 42 m, OSM maxlength/maxwidth), from the canal to the Kiel Fjord. Width as for the Brunsbüttel locks: 40 m stays inside the OSM lock areas and keeps harbour-level cells edge-connected.

properties.name: IJmuiden locks and North Sea Canal (Noordzeekanaal)
source: Geometry: centre line of OSM waterway=canal ways 1243335719, 1243335718, 1105335152; OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), retrieved 2026-10-16 via the Overpass API and simplified to 3 m

Lock dimensions: Port of Amsterdam, exemption regulations for ships transiting Zeesluis IJmuiden, decree 07/2022 (https://www.portofamsterdam.com/sites/default/files/2023-07/220127_07_%20Ontheffingsregels%20passage%20Zeesluis%20IJmuiden-EN_0.pdf)
properties.note: Zeesluis IJmuiden (opened 2022; lockage length 500 m, 70 m between the walls), from the outer harbour to the canal. The OSM water areas are interrupted only at the gates, which this corridor bridges.

properties.name: IJmuiden locks and North Sea Canal (Noordzeekanaal)
properties.source: Geometry: centre line of OSM waterway=canal ways 675852931, 458834170, 106783786; OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), retrieved 2026-10-16 via the Overpass API and simplified to 3 m
properties.note: Noordersluis (400 m x 50 m), the second lock for seagoing ships, from the outer harbour to the canal. The smaller Middensluis, Zuidersluis and Kleine Sluis are left out.

properties.name: IJmuiden locks and North Sea Canal (Noordzeekanaal)
properties.limits_note: Without an exemption (seawater draught, eastbound). With an exemption from the harbour master up to 13.75 m draught; through Zeesluis IJmuiden for example cruise ships up to 362 m x 47 m. The canal is crossed by tunnels and ferries only, so there is no air draft limit.
source: Geometry: centre line of OSM waterway=canal ways 105277152, 1558357913, 928909487, 360632524; OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), retrieved 2026-10-16 via the Overpass API and simplified to 3 m

Limits: Port of Amsterdam, marginal shipping exemptions (https://myport.portofamsterdam.com/en/applications/form/ontheffing-scheepvaart) and the Zeesluis IJmuiden exemption regulations, decree 07/2022 (retrieved 2026-10-16)
properties.note: The North Sea Canal from the IJmuiden locks to the IJ in Amsterdam, ending east of the Passenger Terminal Amsterdam (about 23 km). The 80 m corridor stays inside the OSM canal area.
